description: This file contains the source code for a Mazda Miata 1.6 engine configuration, including rpm and load bins, fuel and ignition tables, engine setup functions, and configuration settings specific to this engine model.

methods.name: miataNAcommon
methods.description: Initializes engine configuration parameters specific to Mazda Miata NA engine, including trigger type, sensor bias resistors, ignition timing, and pin assignments.

methods.name: setMiataNA6_MAP_Configuration
methods.description: Configures engine parameters like sensors, fuel tables, ignition tables, and hardware channels specific to Mazda Miata NA engine with MAP sensor setup.

methods.name: setMiataNA6_VAF_Configuration
methods.description: Sets up the engine configuration using VAF instead of MAP, extending the MAP configuration with fuel algorithm settings.
